# AudioSwitch

Source of `com.github.davidliu:audioswitch` at commit `039a35aefab7747c557242fa216c9ea11743b604`, a fork of
[Twilio AudioSwitch](https://github.com/twilio/audioswitch) that LiveKit Android depends on. It is published only on
JitPack, and blesk takes dependencies only from Maven Central, Google and Signal, so the module is built here from the
unchanged sources and substituted for the JitPack artifact. Licensed under Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`.
